description: Every input the Store's release and generation tooling reads from outside this repository, by the environment variable its consumers read. scripts/release-inputs.py resolves them and refuses by name; nothing here has a default outside the repository.

go.reason: The release builders compile with GOTOOLCHAIN=local, so the local go decides the bytes. Two operators reproduce one release only with one toolchain; the builders refuse any other go before they build.

MEL_RELEASE_SQUADS_EXECUTOR.reason: The generic Squads vault executor the provider's stale-release revoke runs, as scripts/squads-vault-exec.js in a checkout of the deployer at the named commit. That copy is the one canonical copy: it holds every check of every earlier copy, and adds the reduced-mode refusal, which it loads from lib/reduced-mode-guard.cjs beside it. Its Squads SDK resolves from node_modules beside it. Any other copy, guard or SDK tree is refused by its sha256. Both providers run it under sidecar/melusina-store-sidecar/scripts/node-module-confinement.cjs with NODE_OPTIONS and NODE_PATH cleared, admitting only the executor and those two companions: a module the SDK tree lacks is refused as not found, never loaded from an ancestor node_modules, NODE_PATH, a global folder such as /usr/share/nodejs, or the sibling license104 trees the executor searches itself when a module does not resolve.

MEL_RELEASE_PEARL_TOOL.reason: The melusina-pearl-tool binary that prepares and finalizes a candidate RELEASE.json. Name it and pin it with MEL_RELEASE_PEARL_TOOL_SHA256.

MEL_RELEASE_SQUADS_NODE_MODULES.reason: The node_modules directory holding @solana/web3.js and @sqds/multisig for the Store's own Squads helper. Name it and pin its tree digest with MEL_RELEASE_SQUADS_NODE_MODULES_SHA256. The helper runs under node-module-confinement.cjs admitting only this tree, so a module it lacks is refused as not found, never loaded from outside it.

MEL_RELEASE_NODE_MODULES.reason: The shell provider's name for the Squads SDK node_modules directory. Name it and pin its tree digest with MEL_RELEASE_NODE_MODULES_SHA256. The helper runs under node-module-confinement.cjs admitting only this tree, so a module it lacks is refused as not found, never loaded from outside it.

MEL_RELEASE_REGISTER_EXECUTOR.reason: The Store's Squads helper. Unset, it is this repository's copy; any other file must be pinned with MEL_RELEASE_REGISTER_EXECUTOR_SHA256.

MEL_RELEASE_RUNTIME_ENV.reason: The runtime module the default-Bazaar wrapper sources, which names the operator's identity files. It is executed, so pin it with MEL_RELEASE_RUNTIME_ENV_SHA256.

MEL_RELEASE_STATE_DIR.reason: The release state directory mel-release writes, fresh or already stamped for this estate's profile and Store (mel-release refuses any other). It is state, not a content input.

MEL_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT.reason: The directory of clean app checkouts; the catalog adapter checks each one against the catalog's source_commit, so it is not content-pinned here.

MEL_RELEASE_STORE_PUBKEY.reason: The Store's public identity file, named by the runtime module. Its contents are checked against the expected identity and, by mel-release, against the estate profile's store.operatorKey.

MEL_RELEASE_PUBLISHER_KEY.reason: The governed publisher's signing key, named by the runtime module. A credential: named, never defaulted, not content-pinned.

MEL_RELEASE_AUTHOR_KEYPAIR.reason: The release author keypair. A credential: named, never defaulted, not content-pinned.

MEL_RELEASE_SQUADS_MEMBERS.reason: Comma-separated absolute paths of the Squads member keypairs. Credentials: named, never defaulted; the Squads program decides whether each is a member.

RELEASE_JSON_STUB.reason: The spkmodule release-json-stub that writes an offline RELEASE.json. It is executed, so pin it with RELEASE_JSON_STUB_SHA256.

MELUSINA_DEPLOYER_MANIFEST.reason: The deployer approval manifest that preflight gate 2 and doctor read and manifest-merge edits. Pin it with MELUSINA_DEPLOYER_MANIFEST_SHA256; manifest-merge prints the new digest after an edit.

MELUSINA_BUNDLE_TARBALL.reason: The Sandstorm bundle sandstorm-<build>.tar.xz that build-store.sh signs into update/. Setting it requests the bundle update; pin it with MELUSINA_BUNDLE_TARBALL_SHA256.

MELUSINA_BUNDLE_UPDATE_TOOL.reason: The Sandstorm update-tool that signs the bundle. Pin it with MELUSINA_BUNDLE_UPDATE_TOOL_SHA256.

MELUSINA_BUNDLE_UPDATE_KEYRING.reason: The update keyring the update-tool signs with. Pin it with MELUSINA_BUNDLE_UPDATE_KEYRING_SHA256.

MELUSINA_BUNDLE_INSTALL_SH.reason: Optional: an install.sh to publish beside the bundle. Unset, the live update/install.sh is preserved. Pin it with MELUSINA_BUNDLE_INSTALL_SH_SHA256.

SANDSTORM_SRC.reason: build-store.sh no longer scans a Sandstorm checkout (it defaulted to a Sandstorm working tree beside this repository). Name each bundle input: MELUSINA_BUNDLE_TARBALL, MELUSINA_BUNDLE_UPDATE_TOOL, MELUSINA_BUNDLE_UPDATE_KEYRING and optionally MELUSINA_BUNDLE_INSTALL_SH, each with its _SHA256 pin.

DEPLOY_UI_SRC.reason: build-store.sh no longer compiles deploy-ui from a Melusina working tree into releases/. Installer releases are published by their own governed ceremony; build-store.sh only carries the live releases/ tree across.
